notes: All 649 physical subject rows / 640 family-card identities across 14 sections are reconciled to original Name/Team/Rookie cell origins. Base Card Autograps remains literal, with exact paper/chrome/insert autograph aliases. The checked official product text publishes no numeric parallel ladder. Store February 18, 2026 availability and Product Year 2026 are separate from the 2025 checklist title. General release date and exhaustive parallel numbering remain unverified.
